repos_data.description: Near-lock-free structured logging for Rust. 10-crate workspace: MCP server (Claude/Cursor/mcp.run), OTLP HTTP+gRPC exporter, Tower middleware, WASM + WASI 0.2 component, eBPF-style enrichers, PII redaction, log analytics, test utilities, and a jq-style CLI. Sub-µs ingest via a 65k-slot ring buffer (LMAX Disruptor).
